text: Nine tribes once kept the Loom, one Strand each, and their camps still keep time. Every camp is built around a **Tribe Hearth**.
Feed the hearth and the tribe starts to know you. That is your **standing**, and it opens their trades, their secrets and, in the end, their Mark.

pages.title: A tribe camp
text: A camp is easy to spot: a hearth trailing coloured smoke, a Tribe Banner beside it, and four Kin going about their day. The banner's colour names the tribe.

pages.title: Where the tribes live
text: Each tribe camps in the land that suits its Strand:
- **Pad-keepers**: plains.
- **Grit-singers**: mountains and stony shores.
- **Rootbinders**: forests and jungles.
- **Edge-walkers**: taiga.
- **Drumhearts**: savanna.
- **Pattern-weavers**: birch forests.
- **Colony-keepers**: flower forests, meadows and cherry groves.
- **Seal-carvers**: dark forests.
- **Loom-stitchers**: only the Crystal Fields of the March.
Every tribe also keeps a camp in each band of [the March](the_march), built in that band's wood and stone.

steps.caption: Every camp is built around its Tribe Hearth. This is where you make friends.
The Tribe Banner beside it names the tribe by its colour. Leave it standing.
A loom nearby is where the camp's Weaver works. The four Kin never stray more than 16 blocks.
Right-click the hearth with something the tribe favours. Bread earns the Pad-keepers' +3 standing.
Right-click it with an empty hand any time to see your standing and your rank.

pages.title: What to offer
text: Right-click the hearth with an offering in your hand. It takes one item at a time:
- The tribe's **reagent**: **+8** standing.
- The tribe's own [dish](tribe_dishes): **+6**.
- A **favoured** item: **+3**.
- Any other **food**: **+1**.
- A charged **Pulse Cell**: the hearth drinks up to **40 Pulse** from it and gives **+2 for every 10**, so at most **+8**. The cell needs at least 10 Pulse in it.

Reagents: Pad-keepers **Echo Shard**, Grit-singers **Attuned Echo**, Rootbinders **Mossback Scale**, Edge-walkers **Rift Tooth**, Drumhearts **Bone Chime**, Pattern-weavers **Storm Wing**, Colony-keepers **Lantern Down**, Seal-carvers **Spirit Shard**, Loom-stitchers **Loom Thread**. Each tribe's own page lists its favourites too.
Things the tribe has no use for stay in your hand, and the hearth says so. A cell holding less than **10 Pulse** is simply ignored.

pages.title: How fast it grows
text: A tribe's hearth accepts at most **60 standing a day** from your offerings. After that it tells you the tribe has taken all it will today, and near the limit a gift worth more than what is left stays in your hand. Seventeen favoured offerings (51) or seven reagents (56) are enough for **Guest** on your first day.

Three more roads are open, and none of them counts against the hearth's limit. Kill a hostile mob within **24 blocks** of a hearth for **+1**, up to **twenty a day** for each tribe. The kill must be your own: a foe your familiar fells earns nothing. Every trade with the Elder gives **+2**. And once you are a Guest, the Elder's [requests](elders_and_stories) pay **8 to 16** each.

On the tribe's [festival day](living_march), joining the Elder's feast pays **40** standing and two bowls of their dish, a rite in their camp pays **30** more, and a feast eaten by their hearth **20**. Each counts once per festival.
Voice takes many days. Offerings alone will never get you there in one.

pages.title: The ranks
text: - **Stranger** (below 50): the Elder has nothing for you yet.
- **Guest** (50): the Elder opens the first two trades.
- **Friend** (150): two more trades, plus the tribe's own dish for four of its March crop.
- **Kin** (400): the last two trades, the tribe's [boon](tribe_boons) for as long as you keep the standing, and its crest: a **banner pattern** for any loom.
- **Voice** (800): the Elder presses a **Tribe Mark** into your hand, once for each tribe. The Mark is the key to a [Kinship Totem](kinship_totem), and it opens that tribe's own page in this book.
Your standing with the Grit-singers also decides how deep a [Listening Pit](listening_pit) may listen.

pages.title: What never to do
text: - **Hitting a Kin** costs **25** standing, and every Kin of that tribe within 24 blocks turns on you. The Hunters attack you for a **minute**.
- **Breaking the hearth** costs **40** and sets the Hunters on you the same way.
- **Breaking a banner** costs **5**.
Standing can fall below a rank you have earned. A red message tells you when you have slipped.

pages.title: Keeping count
text: Type **/tribalpower standing** to see all nine tribes at once, with your standing and rank for each.
A comparator next to a hearth reads the rank of the last player who used it: **0** for a Stranger up to **15** for a Voice. Handy for a door that only opens for friends of the tribe.

If you belong to a [shared camp](shared_camps), a quarter of every standing a member gains or loses after joining lands on the camp too. Wherever your rank matters, the camp's counts when it is higher than your own.
